metaTitle: Solar Generator vs Gas Generator Camping
description: Compare solar generators and gas inverter generators for camping on noise, safety, runtime, cost and campground rules to choose the right power source.
directAnswer: A solar generator is silent and fume-free and suits loads under about 1,000 Wh a day. A gas inverter generator wins for heavy loads like RV air conditioning or several shady days, but it is loud and produces carbon monoxide.
